messages:
maya: Heads up, cost dashboard showing some routes with negative cache savings after yesterday's router rollout.
alex: which routes / tenants? any P0 impact?
maya: tenant=pilot-retail, route=/v1/chat/receipt-summarize, delta ~ -$0.03 per 1k invocations over a 2h window.
sam: sounds like double attribution between prefetch and batch amortize. did the rollout add a second amortize step?
jordan: router PR 4681 added an amortize pass when prefetched on dedicated pools to avoid overstating savings. maybe it's applied twice when requests re-enter the batch attributor.
ops-bot: deployment note: router v2.3.1 rolled at 02:10 UTC. Tracing sampling for tokenlineage at 1%.
sam: can we bump lineage sampling to 5% for affected routes and dump a few request traces? need to confirm duplicate credit ids.
maya: i'm +1 for sampling bump. also propose we add an internal-only column in the console to show raw cache_credit and credit_sources. public UI can floor negative savings to 0 as a temporary measure.
alex: i'll do the UI PR to floor displayed values and add the internal column behind a feature flag. will include tooltip explaining the diagnostic.
jordan: backend action: add idempotency check in token-attributor so credit_id can't be applied twice in same window. i'll open INF-2201 and add unit tests.
sam: routing guard idea: only apply prefetch amortization if prefetch.pool == last_hotpath.pool OR time_since_last_hotpath < 5m. reduces cross-pool double-credit cases.
maya: rollout plan: 1) UI floor + internal column (feature flag), 2) bump sampling, 3) backend idempotency + pool guard behind flags, 4) monitor econ panel and then enable globally.
ops-bot: INF-2201 created. Tracing sampling increased to 5% for flagged routes.
alex: ETA EOD for UI PR, will post link here. jordan: will start backend patch tomorrow morning.
maya: thanks all. follow-ups: alex PR, jordan INF-2201 fix, sam econ sim once we have traces, maya add console alert for negative savings trends. tagging @alex @jordan for standup. :thumbsup:
